selection_provenance.v1_outcome: rejected after corrected fixed-training-scale NRMSE analysis
selection_provenance.v2_kill_rule_outcome: failed because learned gain improved only 0.222929 percent over the prespecified fixed-gain comparator
selection_provenance.v3_candidate_selection: fixed equal-trust gain 0.5 was selected from the prespecified v2 fixed-gain comparator before any v3 seed was generated

candidate.novelty_boundary: application-level composition of a prespecified complementary context filter and physics-residual probabilistic rollout; no claim of novelty for complementary or Kalman-style filtering

data_design.pairing: all methods share one deterministic dataset per seed/system; ID-clean and ID-corrupt reuse the same underlying trajectory identifiers; OOD identifiers must be disjoint from all ID identifiers
data_design.independence_boundary: the eight seed-level training/data realizations are the top-level independent clusters; trajectories are nested repeated observations
data_design.generalization_boundary: claims apply to the prespecified finite five-system benchmark and stochastic training/data realizations, not to all physical systems

training.resume_policy: only an exact provenance-bound subset with paired JSON/checkpoint artifacts may resume

statistics.primary_estimand: arithmetic mean across eight seed-specific relative improvements; within each seed, baseline and candidate means are equally weighted across all fixed system-regime cells
statistics.absolute_estimand: arithmetic mean across seed-specific proposed-minus-baseline fixed-cell mean differences
statistics.bootstrap: resample seeds globally with replacement; within each selected seed/system, resample paired trajectory identifiers; reuse one sampled identifier vector for regimes sharing the same underlying trajectories; resample the distinct OOD trajectory set separately; retain every system-regime cell
statistics.relative_ratio_rule: recompute baseline, candidate, and their relative ratio inside every bootstrap replicate
statistics.exact_test: enumerate all 2^8 seed-level sign flips under a prespecified symmetry assumption
statistics.h1: CFR-WM seed-mean relative NRMSE-25 improvement over the preselected PGNN comparator is at least 5 percent
statistics.h1_success_rule: all metrics finite AND lower endpoint of relative-improvement 95 percent bootstrap interval is at least 5 percent AND one-sided exact sign-flip p value for the 5 percent margin is below 0.05
statistics.h2: conditional on H1, corrupt plus shifted regimes improve by at least 5 percent and clean-regime performance is noninferior within a 5 percent degradation margin
statistics.h2_success_rule: H1 succeeds AND all metrics finite AND corrupt/shifted relative-CI lower endpoint is at least 5 percent with one-sided margin p below 0.05 AND clean relative-CI lower endpoint is at least -5 percent with one-sided margin p below 0.05
statistics.confirmation_pass_rule: H1 only; H2 is a hierarchically gated secondary robustness claim

multiplicity_families.five_broad_comparator_contrasts: Holm adjustment of two-sided exact seed sign-flip p values
multiplicity_families.five_cfr_ablation_and_sensitivity_contra: Holm adjustment of two-sided exact seed sign-flip p values
multiplicity_families.fifteen_system_regime_contrasts: descriptive effect estimates and unadjusted bootstrap intervals only; no cell-level significance claim

statistics.cell_degradation_guard: number of fixed cells with CFR-WM more than 10 percent worse than PGNN is descriptive and cannot override or rescue H1

freeze_rules: No interim confirmatory metric inspection is permitted.
No method, seed, system, regime, hyperparameter, metric, margin, multiplicity family, or success rule may change after the first confirmatory dataset is generated.
Any code, analysis, tuning, contract, or payload provenance mismatch must abort before new data generation or analysis.
The generic experiment CLI must reject every frozen confirmatory seed and the reserved confirmatory output directory.
Negative or inconclusive results must be reported without redefining the hypotheses.
Learned-gain PFR-WM is prohibited from this confirmatory grid because its frozen development kill rule failed.
